𝐅𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐥𝐥, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟏.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Inspired by a true story told by Dutch investigative journalist Joris Luyendijk in his book “Swimming with Sharks”, this movie takes place on the morning of September 11, 2001. While millions of people around the world watched the attacks unfold in horror, one young trader at a London investment bank saw something completely different: an opportunity. Although the film is fictionalized, it is based on an anonymous account shared with Luyendijk by a real investment banker during his research into London’s financial world.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
The premise is as simple as it is disturbing. As news of the first plane reaches the trading floor, confusion spreads throughout the office. Most traders freeze, unsure whether they are witnessing a tragic accident or something far worse. But one man immediately realizes that if this is a coordinated terrorist attack, the financial markets are about to collapse. Instead of staring at the television in disbelief, he picks up the phone and places the biggest trade of his career.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
In that moment, the audience is confronted with an uncomfortable truth. Every major event creates both winners and losers. While thousands of innocent people were fighting for their lives inside the World Trade Center, others were making fortunes from the disaster. Imagine the emotional conflict. On one side, you have the greatest financial success of your life. On the other, you are watching one of history’s darkest moments unfold live on television.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
What makes 𝐅𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐥𝐥 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟏) so powerful is that it never portrays its protagonist as a villain. He is simply a product of the environment he works in. Traders are trained to react faster than everyone else and to profit from uncertainty. On September 11, those instincts collided with one of the greatest human tragedies of the twenty-first century.
